body.title: jira_project (7 ops) and jira_auth (1 op)
body.summary: Create project.ts (list, view, create from an existing project, update, archive, restore, delete) and auth.ts (status) with fields, rules, classes, limits and answer builders; the project mutation readers accept the success mark only until the probe records the real text.
acceptanceChecks: project create requires fromProject, key and name and builds acli jira project create --from-project SRC --key NEW --name N with optional --description, --url and --lead-email, never --from-json or --generate-json
project archive and delete are destructive, create, update and restore are common, list and view are none; list takes exactly one of limit (1 to 200, default 30) and recent
jira_auth status is class none and reads the sign-in state without any model call

tests.name: jira-project-auth.test.ts: every project op and auth status returns its declared shape and its argv matches acli
jira-project-auth.test.ts: project create needs fromProject and a non-company-managed source is a rejected failure
